name: midRoute
meaning: Sam.followFlags bit 0: after reaching a waypoint Sam sets it to waypointCount > 1, i.e. the new target is an intermediate path node, not the goal; cleared by EnterFollowNodeState

name: dropping
meaning: bit 1: set (0x469538) while midRoute when the ground under the next step is more than 100 lower, or dropToNode was set this frame; Sam then commits to the drop and ignores the pursuit-zone exit and authorized-zone turn-back checks. Cleared on the next waypoint and by EnterFollowNodeState

name: dropToNode
meaning: bit 2: set (0x469336) while midRoute and not dropping when the current waypoint is more than 40 below Sam; route Y velocity 2000 instead of 1000, and SAM_STT_FOLLOWNODES skips the per-frame goal/notice block. Cleared on the next waypoint and by EnterFollowNodeState
